title: GSE Panel

minimum_os.name: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS or newer, or Debian 12 or newer
minimum_os.note: Any OS with PHP 8.1 or newer works in theory. These are the releases that ship it.

tested_on.name: Ubuntu 24.04 LTS with PHP 8.3
tested_on.note: Runs against the dev Linux agent (2026-11-12).

tested_on.name: PHP 8.1 (Ubuntu 22.04) and PHP 8.2 (Debian 12)
tested_on.note: Syntax check of every .php file only (2026-11-12). Not run live.

prerequisites.name: PHP 8.3 (recommended), 8.1 or newer (minimum)
prerequisites.note: 8.3 is what the panel is developed and tested on. Every file also passes php -l on 8.1 and 8.2.

prerequisites.name: PHP extensions: mysqli, curl, mbstring, gd, xmlrpc
prerequisites.note: Ubuntu/Debian: apt install php-mysql php-curl php-mbstring php-gd php-xmlrpc. xmlrpc is needed to talk to the agents.

prerequisites.name: Web server (Apache or nginx) with PHP

unverified: The database and web server versions are not yet set or tested.
